name: dia-text-reveal
title: Dia Text Reveal
description: A soft multi-colour gradient band sweeps left to right across the text, revealing the letters behind it; with several texts it then swaps to the next and sweeps again.
useWhen: A headline should be revealed by a smooth colour wash that settles into the normal text colour.
A few phrases should take turns, each revealed the same way.
avoidWhen: The reveal should be letter by letter or word by word: use per-character-rise or per-word-rise.
A gloss that passes over text already on screen is enough: use text-shimmer.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The text to reveal. Separate several texts with | to take turns when Repeat is on.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Band colours
variables.description: Colours across the moving band, comma separated.

variables.label: Sweep time
variables.description: Seconds one sweep takes (the source uses 1.5).

variables.label: Repeat
variables.description: With several texts, move on to the next after each sweep.

variables.label: Pause between texts
variables.description: Seconds between a finished sweep and the next text.
